summary: FAILED VERIFICATION. The gap analysis contains multiple critical factual errors claiming that specifications do not exist when they actually do. Key false claims: (1) Random Events spec marked as '30% coverage / Major Gap' when a comprehensive 42KB specification exists; (2) Ship Components listed as 'Critical Gap' when components-complete.md exists with full stats; (3) Weapons list marked as missing when weapons-complete.md and weapons.md tech tree both exist; (4) Victory Conditions marked as '60% / Needs Work' when a 40KB specification exists; (5) Slider System listed as needing specification when slider-mathematics.md exists. The gap analysis methodology appears to have failed to properly inventory existing design documents. The document structure and formatting are good, but the core factual content is unreliable. Recommend re-running the analysis with proper file system verification before making gap claims.
